items.title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
items.description: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

items.title: MetaVia sees GLP-1 shed liver fat and body weight in phase 1, takes aim at specific liver disease
items.description: MetaVia has linked its GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist to reductions in liver fat and body weight in a phase 1 trial. Encouraged by the data, MetaVia plans to start a phase 2 trial in alcohol-associated liver disease next year.
